verdict.rationale: Devin ships an official, documented CLI ('Devin for Terminal' / Devin CLI) for local interactive coding from the command line. Documented features include /handoff to cloud Devin, Adaptive model routing with /model switching, MCP tool-server extensibility under a permission system, and slash commands, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence on installation, auth, and non-interactive/scripted usage.
